'''Red Rage''' was a type of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] used by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] which increased the imbiber's power at the cost of their [[Eye/Legends|eyesight]].
